subject.title: fix: surface cron errors for empty isolated agent replies

question: Should existing delivery-requested isolated cron runs with no final deliverable and no recognized committed terminal side effect now fail visibly rather than remain silently successful?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent, but choosing a visible failure notification over the historical silent-success behavior is an operator-facing compatibility contract that needs owner intent.

options.title: Adopt visible cron failure
options.body: Accept the new contract: empty delivery-requested completions are errors unless explicit silence or committed terminal evidence proves the target was already satisfied.

options.title: Preserve silent completion
options.body: Retain the prior outcome and pursue a separate opt-in diagnostic or retry policy if operators need visibility without changing existing cron success semantics.

recommendation.title: Adopt visible cron failure
recommendation.body: Accept the new contract: empty delivery-requested completions are errors unless explicit silence or committed terminal evidence proves the target was already satisfied.
